facts: Parties: Bellhaven Energy plc (Company) and Bellhaven Pharma Securities (Underwriter).

Clause 9: the Underwriters may offer the Shares to investors in the United States, Canada and the European Economic Area. No selling restrictions or exemption conditions are specified for any jurisdiction.
Clause 4: the Company grants the Underwriters an option to purchase up to 2,000,000 additional shares (the Over-allotment Option), representing 15% of the 10,000,000 Firm Shares.
Issuer: Bellhaven Energy plc. The date of this Prospectus is 3 January 2027.
Legal Proceedings: the Company is not party to any legal proceedings which may have a significant effect on its financial position.
Related Party Transactions: there are no related party transactions other than directors' service agreements.
Item 3: the board discussed a class action filed by Whitlock Systems Ltd seeking $8,000,000 in damages. Counsel assesses the claim as having reasonable prospects.
Item 7: the board approved a loan of $6,250,000 from the Company to Felix Yardley, a director, on interest-free terms.
